read.thesis: Gildan Q2 CY26 adj. operating margin 22.3% and adj. EPS $1.28 beat, but leverage is 3.2x with debt-funded Hanes and wholesale sell-in cut by inventory reduction; supply rationalisation (plant closures) is real.

capex.quote: with the required capital investment expected to fit within the Company's current budget and plans

triggers.label: Plant closures after Hanes integration
triggers.quote: closures of manufacturing facilities, including a hosiery manufacturing facility, two textile manufacturing facilities, and a sewing facility

triggers.label: Wholesale sell-in down 1.5% in Q2
triggers.quote: Wholesale sales were $769 million compared to $781 million, down 1.5% versus the prior year

triggers.label: Adj. op margin 22.3% vs ~19.7% guide
triggers.quote: Adjusted operating margin was 22.3% of net sales, down 40 basis points versus last year but 260 basis points ahead of guidance of around 19.7%

triggers.label: Leverage 3.2x vs 1.5-2.5x target
triggers.quote: Gildan's net debt leverage ratio as at June 28, 2026 was 3.2 times

guidance.quote: in line with guidance of approximately $1.6 billion
The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2026
Initial production at the facility is expected to start in the latter part of 2027

prior_guidance_check.quote: in line with guidance of approximately $1.6 billion

red_flags.label: Repeated large non-cash write-offs and restructuring
red_flags.quote: write-off of equipment related to facility closures associated with the integration of Hanes (Q1 2026: $14.4 million and Q2 2026: $66.6 million)

red_flags.label: Leverage above target, buybacks paused
red_flags.quote: As a result of the closing of the Hanes acquisition, our net debt leverage ratio exceeds our stated target range
